content.text: 用 MCP 打 test 海豚接口，同时核对本地配置与可达性。

mcpDetails.description: List DolphinScheduler projects on test env to verify login

input.command:
ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/dolphin_ops/config/ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/dolphinscheduler.json 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/dc-platform.json 2>/dev/null; python3 -c '
import json,os
for p in [
 "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/dolphin_ops/config/dolphinscheduler.json",
 "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/dolphinscheduler.json",
]:
  if os.path.exists(p):
    d=json.load(open(p))
    t=d.get("test",{})
    print(p)
    print("base_url:", t.get("base_url"))
    tok=t.get("token") or ""
    print("token_len:", len(tok), "token_prefix:", tok[:6]+"..." if tok else "EMPTY")
' 2>&1
if [ -f /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/dolphin_ops/run.sh ]; then
  cd /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/dolphin_ops && ./run.sh ping --env test 2>&1 | head -40
fi
